gh_a4413b38ce8666beb7e0dc7d.title: [Remoto] Senior Front-end / Product Engineer na WeatherWise — 4 dias / 32h
gh_a4413b38ce8666beb7e0dc7d.description:
## Nossa empresa

WeatherWise (Ehabitation Ltd, trading as EHAB) is a London-based weather risk specialist helping construction, energy, agriculture and logistics businesses understand, plan for and insure against weather risk.

We run WeatherWise Construction (weather-delay analysis and schedule risk) and WeatherWise Studio (an AI-native parametric insurance platform). Our agent, Kite, helps brokers discover relevant weather events, structure and price cover, generate client materials and route submissions to suitable carriers. A weather-data engine drawing on 180,000+ stations and global datasets powers both platforms.

Our team is small and senior. Trust, auditability and correctness matter. Website: https://www.ehab.co/

## Descrição da vaga

**Semana de trabalho de 4 dias — 32 horas semanais.**
**Remuneração mensal: R$ 15.000 a R$ 25.000, conforme experiência.**

**Senior Front-end / Product Engineer (Design-led), reporting to the CTO.**

Design and build the interfaces through which brokers, insurers and contractors work with an agentic AI platform. Own the product surface, from first sketch to shipped product: agent conversations, policy-structuring workbenches, insurer appetite dashboards, risk dashboards and microsites.

There is no separate design team. You will take ambiguous workflows, sketch and prototype them, test with users and ship. The central challenge is designing for an agent: explaining what Kite did and why, surfacing uncertainty and making human review, correction and approval clear and effective.

- Design and build the frontend of both platforms, from information architecture to visual detail.
- Own the design system, component library and consistency across products, dashboards and microsites.
- Build interfaces for reviewing, correcting and approving agent output.
- Make complex weather and financial data clear through maps, time series, dense tables, trigger structures, payout curves and portfolio views.
- Use AI coding/design tools to prototype and iterate quickly.
- Run lightweight user research with brokers, carriers and contractors.
- Work directly with the CEO, CTO and sales team to help set product direction.

## Local

100% remoto — trabalhando permanentemente do Brasil com a equipe da WeatherWise, sediada em Londres.

## Requisitos

**Obrigatórios:**
- 6+ years building production web applications, with deep fluency in React or a comparable modern framework and TypeScript.
- Demonstrable design practice: work where you owned UX, visual design and implementation, and can explain the decisions.
- Strong data-visualisation skills and judgement about when to use charts, maps and tables.
- Daily use of AI coding and design tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.
- Experience building interfaces for AI-driven/agentic products, or a credible explanation of how you would approach them.
- Comfort scoping ambiguous problems and shipping independently in a small senior team.

**Desejáveis:**
- MapLibre, Mapbox, deck.gl or time-series visualisation at scale.
- B2B, fintech or insurtech products where trust, auditability and correctness matter.
- Building or maintaining design systems.
- Interest in weather, climate or risk.

We care far more about what you have shipped than which exact tools you used. A portfolio or live work counts for more than a CV.

## Benefícios

- Semana de trabalho de **4 dias / 32 horas semanais**.
- Trabalho **100% remoto do Brasil**.
- Ownership of the company's design direction, with direct access to the CEO and CTO.
- A small senior team building agentic products used by real customers.

## Contratação

**PJ (Pessoa Jurídica). Remuneração mensal de R$ 15.000 a R$ 25.000, conforme experiência.**

## Como se candidatar

Email **josh.graham@weatherwise.studio** with the subject **Senior Front-end / Product Engineer**.

Skip the cover letter. Send two or three things you have built that you are proud of: links, a short Loom or a repo, plus a couple of sentences on what you would change about them now.

## Tempo médio de feedbacks

We will come back to every application and aim to run the process from first conversation to offer in under three weeks. Contact: josh.graham@weatherwise.studio.

#### Regime
- PJ

#### Nível
- Sênior

gh_a4a7d7b8ea3a77260256bf62.title: New Feature Request: Graduation-year and academic-standing filtering
gh_a4a7d7b8ea3a77260256bf62.description:
### Improvement

Following up on #2479, could the list support filtering internships by expected graduation year or academic standing? This would help applicants find relevant roles without opening every posting to check the requirements.
I looked through the list-updater code and `listings.json`. The export includes degree types, but not graduation-date windows or freshman/sophomore/junior/senior requirements. The contribution guide mentions that a private service imports listings from Simplify.
Does Simplify already store this information, and could it be included in the automated export? Missing or ambiguous requirements could remain “unknown” rather than implying eligibility.
I’d be interested in contributing filters to the existing search command using that upstream data. Would this be a welcome contribution, and is exposing the necessary data feasible?

Estamos em busca de um Senior QA Engineer apaixonado por qualidade e automação para integrar o time de uma empresa líder em soluções de inteligência de negócios e dados comerciais. Você será responsável por projetar e manter suites de testes automatizados robustas, garantir cobertura de testes em funcionalidades críticas e colaborar com desenvolvedores e Product Managers para elevar os padrões de qualidade. Se você tem experiência sólida em Cypress, JavaScript, testes E2E e API, além de proficiência em inglês, essa é sua oportunidade!
🎯 O que você fará no dia a dia:
- Projetar, desenvolver, manter e melhorar continuamente suites de testes automatizados utilizando Cypress e JavaScript
- Definir e implementar estratégias eficazes de automação de testes para aplicações web complexas

- Realizar testes de API para validar integrações, regras de negócio e consistência de dados

- Garantir cobertura de testes apropriada para novas funcionalidades, correções e fluxos críticos
- Identificar, documentar e rastrear defeitos com informações técnicas claras
- Utilizar Grafana e Sentry para monitorar comportamento da aplicação e investigar falhas
- Integrar testes automatizados em pipelines CI/CD, garantindo validação contínua
- Mentorizar e apoiar outros engenheiros de QA, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas
✅

- Experiência sólida (mínimo 5 anos) em Garantia de Qualidade de Software e testes de software

- Compreensão sólida de testes E2E, integração, regressão, funcionais e de API
